fr_html: Le PRESIDENT met au vote le premier alinéa de l'amendement de M. Hagerup. Cet amendement est adopté sauf rédaction et sauf la question des frais de voyage. Il est convenu que l'indication faite par M. Altamira sera prise en considération pour le texte du rapport.
en_html: The PRESIDENT put the first Paragraph of M. Hagerup's amendment to the vote. It was adopted, subject to amendment in wording; the question of travelling expenses was left undecided. It was agreed that the suggestions made by M. Altamira would be taken into consideration in the report.
